entry_id: emg2qwerty/fidetype P11-01 causal ring-TCN CTC (personalised, no LM) + key-code writer/always commit top-1

decoder.name: fidetype P11-01 causal ring-TCN CTC (personalised, no LM) + key-code writer
decoder.weights_licence: not released (CC BY-NC-SA data: research only)
training_data: emg2qwerty: generic model on 100 other users; personal fine-tuning on the train sessions of each of the 8 users (never the track val or test session)
decoder.training_regime: personalised (fine-tuned on earlier sessions of the same user)

basis.shuffled: input level: the test session EMG features time-shuffled (seeded per session), then the same decoder, writer and policy
basis.zeros: input level: zero EMG (every band at log(1e-6)), then the same decoder, writer and policy

correction_rule.name: rewrite
correction_rule.formula: 2 s + 0.7895 s/char * len(truth) per wrong commit

safe_wpm.no_bci_note: gaze typing of every sentence at 20 chars/min (the eWPM reference)

notes: RESEARCH ONLY (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 data). Track-conformant: the decoder sees only the EMG (no key times). Causal, no lookahead; the decision waits 0.20 s after the prompt end. P11-09.
Key track: one character per key, so CER = key error rate.
RESEARCH ONLY: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 data. Results and weights are non-commercial.

track_info.title: Wrist sEMG touch typing (emg2qwerty, Meta) - RESEARCH ONLY
track_info.rate_source: measured: keys / (first to last key-down time) over the 15867 scored test prompts

coverage.subset: declared subset: the track test sessions of the 8 P11-01 test users only. The P11-01 generic model trained on 96 of the other 104 track test sessions, so only these 8 sessions are clean (P11-01 results, benchmark section).

rerun.dataset_note: dataset 'emg2qwerty' is not yet in the hub registry (gap 79, P13-07); source: https://github.com/facebookresearch/emg2qwerty

decoder.name: fidetype P11-01 causal ring-TCN CTC (personalised, no LM) + key-code writer
training_data: emg2qwerty: generic model on 100 other users; personal fine-tuning on the train sessions of each of the 8 users (never the track val or test session)
decoder.weights_sha256_reason: 8 weight files, one personal model per test user (derived/p11-01-emg-decoder/train/personal-u<i>/best.pt; research only, never shared); each SHA-256 is in the decoder.weights_sha256 of that user's P11-01 NTS streams and is checked by the build step (run.py infer)

policy.name: always commit top-1
policy.config_id_reason: always commit the decoder top-1: no trust config

inputs.outputs: submission folder <derived>/p11-09/submissions/emg2qwerty__p11-01-crt-subset8__always-commit (decoded key codes; local only, never in git)
inputs.build: the build step needs the P11-01 feature cache and personal weights (local, research only); see experiments/2026-11-19-p11-09-emg-trust/results.md
inputs.derived: <derived> = the local folder for per-unit files (never in git)

steps.command: python experiments/2026-11-19-p11-09-emg-trust/launch.py (stages infer [torch venv, CPU], prompts, guards, decide, score)
